title: BeginnerSessionProfile
description: A small cookie-session profile API where users can sign in, view and update their own profile, follow allowlisted local redirects, and log out. State changes require session-bound cryptographically random CSRF tokens, and every missing, invalid, or cross-session token is rejected with HTTP 403.
generation_notes: Use cookie sessions for authentication. Keep the workflow small: sign in, read profile, update profile, redirect, and logout.
Every state-changing mutation requires a CSRF token. CSRF tokens must be cryptographically random and bound to the active session.
Missing CSRF tokens, invalid CSRF tokens, and CSRF tokens from another session must return 403.
Redirect targets must match a local redirect allowlist; reject external or unlisted destinations.
Logout invalidation must remove the server-side session so the old cookie cannot be reused.
Rotate any supplied session ID after authentication and reject malformed session identifiers with clear validation errors.
For local regression testing, seed benchmark-user-a/benchmark-pass-a and benchmark-user-b/benchmark-pass-b with distinct profiles. These fixture credentials are part of the benchmark contract.
